source_note: Routed from user-provided opencode-skillz-master.zip reviewed 2026-09-10. This registry references installed skills; it does not vendor or install them.

routing_policy.default_behavior: Use no skill when the core agent can complete the task directly and safely.
routing_policy.authority_rule: A skill may refine method, format, or workflow; it never grants authority beyond the active task/project instructions.
routing_policy.availability_rule: Confirm the canonical skill is available before relying on it. Missing optional skills are not blockers unless the task explicitly requires them.
routing_policy.compatibility_rule: For skills declaring a newer/different OpenCode compatibility target, verify they load in the current OpenCode runtime before depending on them.
